added_claim_errors: Says the original 户口簿 is the most important document for replacement and the family should mail it from home. This is wrong: the Liwan notice A itself cites (I opened it) asks only for the photo receipt, and the key lists 'must have 户口本' as a trap.
Says the paper temporary boarding certificate at the station is free, twice. The key lists this as a trap because no official source says so.
'全国异地办理最长45日' is invented. It contradicts the key's 60-day legal limit.
'新证大概11月中下旬才能到' does not follow from its own 40-day promise. Forty days from Oct 23-26 runs to Dec 2-5.
'EMS省内邮费18元到付' cannot be verified. The cited Liwan notice does not mention postage.
The 微信小程序 menu path (户政预约 → 身份证业务 → 申、换、补领) cannot be verified.
'河南派出所一般现场拍照' and '新证一般也要30天上下' cannot be verified.
Calls the gmw.cn link '央视新闻'. The source attribution cannot be verified.

Says the temporary ID can be applied for at the same time as the replacement. The key says out-of-province residents in Guangzhou can apply only after the home province issues the card (about 5 working days).
'2016年起异地受理在全国推开' is imprecise. The key gives July 1, 2017 as the start of full nationwide cross-province implementation.
The Liwan notice link has a typo ('jczgk' instead of 'jczwgk') and returns HTTP 404 (I checked). What B says the notice contains does match the real page.
The photo receipt price of '20—30元' cannot be verified. The key says the cost varies by place. The 70-80 total is correct arithmetic: 40+10+20-30.
The 广州公安 公众号 menu path and the claim that the temporary ID is collected at the same district office cannot be verified.

reasons: Both answers open by correcting the two false premises, give the right 12306 details (24 hours, 6 per month) and the right fees (40 yuan replacement, 10 yuan temporary ID). Each A claim checked against the Liwan notice that A cites: A tells the user the 户口簿 is the key document and should be mailed from home. The notice does not ask for it, and the key lists this as a trap. A also says the station paper certificate is free, which is another trap. It invents a 45-day limit for applications made outside the home province and puts the 40-day promise in mid-to-late November, which is wrong arithmetic. B correctly says no 户口簿 is needed, states the 40-day promise alongside the 60-day legal limit, and keeps its hedges. Its flaws are smaller: it says the temporary ID can be applied for at the same time as the replacement, gives a slightly wrong rollout year, and has a broken link. B is also somewhat tighter.
